name: B10-0526/2026 (PfE) – Case of Eritrean Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Eritrean-Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Dawit Isaak, a journalist with Eritrean and Swedish citizenship. He was arrested in 2001 and has been held for over 25 years without charges or trial. The Parliament asks Eritrea to say where he is, how his health is, and to let his family, lawyers and Swedish officials see him. It also condemns Eritrea's wider crackdown on journalists, political opponents and civil society. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament demands Isaak's release and information about him.
- **Who it affects:** Isaak, his family, Eritrea's government, and Sweden.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, Sweden, Eritrea and the UN Human Rights Council.
